Refrigerator / Freezer Repairs

Stove & Cooktop Repairs

More details

Dishwasher Repairs

If your dishwasher is not powering on, starting or finishing a cycle, filling with water or washing dishes.

Oven Repairs

Not heating up, an unresponsive panel, running too hot or not hot enough, a broken glass door or a burnt-out light.

Garbage Disposal Repairs

How it works

From the first call to a working appliance in three steps.

1
1

Schedule an appointment

Call or text (971) 800-1075, or use online booking. Please provide your name, address, phone number and appliance type with a brief description of the issue.

2
2

Diagnostics

During the diagnostic process, we will troubleshoot, discuss and agree upon the repair price and terms. If necessary, we will order any required spare parts to complete the repair.

3
3

Repairs

All repairs are completed as quickly as possible. Please note that payment of the agreed-upon amount is required upon completion of the repair.
